label: Claude Desktop
restart: Quit Claude Desktop completely (Claude menu, Quit) and open it again.

label: Claude Code
restart: Start a new Claude Code session; /mcp lists the server.

label: Cursor
restart: Restart Cursor, or open Settings, MCP and switch the server on.

label: VS Code
restart: Open a new Copilot chat in agent mode; VS Code asks once to trust the server.

label: Gemini CLI
restart: Start a new Gemini CLI session; /mcp lists the server.

label: Windsurf
restart: Restart Windsurf, or press refresh in its MCP panel.
